name: Kyobo Securities Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kyobo Securities Co., Ltd., a securities company, engages in trading, brokerage, agency, and underwriting of listed securities businesses in South Korea. It is involved in consignment trading of securities, brokerage or agency of trading, and related business activities; and business activities related to stocks, bonds, and stock indices for trading purposes, as well as related to derivatives traded on and off the exchange, such as futures and options. The company also provides investment banking services, including securities acquisition, sales, and arrangement; M&A brokerage; corporate financing and operation consulting; asset securitization; and project financing.
